description: First-load JavaScript budgets per page, gzip, in kB of 1,000 bytes (BLUEPRINT §11.4). A page not named here gets defaultKb. Checked by pnpm --filter web js-budget after pnpm build; how it measures is in scripts/js-budget.ts.

/.reason: Public page opened on phones before sign-in, kept near its measured size (175.8 kB on 28-09-2026, plus 5 %) rather than the 250 kB default.

/_not-found.reason: The page shown for an address that does not exist, public like the sign-in pages, kept near its measured size (175.8 kB on 28-09-2026, plus 5 %) rather than the 250 kB default.

/admin/activity.reason: Staff screen, over the 250 kB target: every staff page loads the whole UI kit through its index (Radix dialog and menu, toasts, the palette's cmdk, tailwind-merge: about 63 kB, because Turbopack cannot drop the kit's unused modules) and the app shell (about 14 kB), plus its own screen code (about 10 kB); the contracts and Zod no longer reach the browser. Measured 263.9 kB on 28-09-2026, plus 5 %. Lower it when the UI kit loads per component.
